Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the directors’ death dates—assigning August 30, 2000 to Marshall Neilan and October 27, 1958 to Joseph H. Lewis—despite earlier steps correctly retrieving the opposite (Neilan: 1958; Lewis: 2000). This reversal led to an incorrect conclusion that His Last Haul’s director died later.
